title: Build CKC/Ingest dataset mining review pipeline
operator_request: Image ingest should select large datasets, mark images pass/reject/unsure, batch add tags/notes such as events/dates/location, and link passed images to a character sheet.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Treat Ingest as a sibling Atelier tab and reuse CKC media linking instead of creating a disconnected sorter.

scope.summary: Make Ingest a real image-mining front end for CKC and LoRA dataset preparation.
base_scope: Select/import a large image dataset non-destructively.
Batch apply tags, notes, event names, dates, locations, and source metadata.
Link passed images to CKC character sheets/albums.
Make review state attributable and safe for parallel agents.
Update internal UserManual with Ingest review workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest tab exposes dataset selection and review states.
Batch metadata can be applied without losing per-image notes.
Passed images can be linked to CKC characters.
Argus can inspect and steer the review workflow.
verification: Backend tests for ingest review states and batch metadata.
Native UI tests for review controls.

validation_v1.validated_by: INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR (acting as per-MT WP Validator per Operator directive)
validation_v1.method: Committed-source review (git base 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 14 read-only sub-agents that each read Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL. Adjudicated against independently-verified git ground truth. Fresh runtime re-execution was ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM at validation time (backend later recompiled clean after Operator freed memory).
validation_v1.basis: Intake pipeline committed and reviewed, but its managed-PG/EventLedger proof binary does not compile at HEAD -> SR2 not established.
validation_v1.fail_report: MT-017's intake pipeline is committed (97a87db0, intake.rs + migration 0341) and reviewed, but its managed-PostgreSQL/EventLedger proof (canonical classifications, transactional rollback, foreign-override rejection, direct EventLedger query event_family=INTAKE_ITEM_CLASSIFIED, collection membership) lives in tests/atelier_core_data_tests.rs, which FAILS TO COMPILE at committed HEAD: rustc E0382 borrow-after-move at :1999 (moved) / :2054 (borrowed). Verified by cargo test --no-run at HEAD (file is committed-clean). Because the whole test binary does not build, none of its intake/EventLedger assertions can execute, so SR2 (managed-resource proof) is not established.
validation_v1.remediation_plan: 1) Fix tests/atelier_core_data_tests.rs:1999 -> request_id: Some(metadata_request_id.clone()). 2) Confirm cargo test --no-run --test atelier_core_data_tests succeeds. 3) Run the MT-017 intake classification/rollback/EventLedger tests against managed PostgreSQL; record the pass. 4) Re-submit for validation.
